memory_candidates.title: A set-level realization hypothesis can survive the pumping argument that kills its trace-level form
memory_candidates.body: When a trace-set equality hypothesis (every seam trace is a run trace and conversely) is refuted by pigeonhole-plus-pumping on Fintype.card Q, the weaker equality of finite INVARIANT sets derived from those traces need not fall with it. Two reasons, both reusable: the local-run inheritance lemma that the refutation routes through is unavailable under the weaker hypothesis, and the realization demand becomes finite (finitely many invariants), so a finite presentation no longer needs an unbounded stretch and the pigeonhole has nothing to pigeonhole. Check both before reusing a refutation at a weaker level.

memory_candidates.title: Truncate an infinite index by finiteness of the target, not by a saturation lemma
memory_candidates.body: To show a union over an infinite index equals a union over a finite sub-index, do not reach for a saturation/threshold lemma on the index. If the union is already known finite (Set.Finite), pick one witnessing index per member, map the witnesses to a well-ordered parameter, and bound them with Set.Finite.bddAbove. This needs no structural lemma about the index and no evaluation of the invariants -- but it is non-constructive by construction, so it establishes existence while yielding no computable bound. Name that consequence explicitly rather than letting a reader assume a bound fell out.

memory_candidates.title: An IsRun-style 'marker exactly once' condition pins a bi-infinite run with no acceptance condition
memory_candidates.body: A run condition of the shape 'for all z, lab (rho z) marker = true iff z = t' is far stronger than it looks: it excludes the run that never reaches the marker state, so a presentation needs no acceptance or liveness condition to rule out degenerate runs. Combined with a state graph whose marker state has a single predecessor that is its own single predecessor, it pins the run completely on the backward side and leaves only the forward branching to enumerate. Useful whenever a finite presentation must realize exactly a prescribed finite set of bi-infinite traces.
